rows.label: qst500201_msg0001
rows.name:
It's unusual for someone to come all
the way out here and talk to Foorara,
mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0002
rows.name:
Foorara isn't trying to do anything
dangerous, mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0003
rows.name:
Nopon born in Fortis Trade Guild
traditionally set out alone at age
five, mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0004
rows.name:
First, I came to Goldmund to see
the Nopon at Avaritia Trading
Company, mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0005
rows.name:
So I was watching the salvagers from
here and studying how they work, mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0006
rows.name:
But the thought of Foorara having to
work that hard as an adult makes the
future seem a little bleak, mo...

rows.label: qst500201_msg0007
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says to move on when you feel sad,
mo.

rows.label: qst500201_msg0008
rows.name:
Next I want somewhere with a better
view so I can feel refreshed, mo!

rows.label: qst500201_msg0009
rows.name:
If fate brings us together again,
take care of me, mo.
